Heading.RuleExplanation.BullyHeader: Treat others how you want to be treated
Description.BullyDetail: It's against the rules to say mean things to someone or about another person. It’s also against the rules to exclude someone because of who they are, where they come from, or what they believe.
Description.BullyImportance: To keep Boiby fun and safe for everyone, we don’t use words or actions that are intended to harm or bully others. Boiby is for everyone, regardless of background and beliefs.
Heading.RuleExplanation.PIIHeader: Don't share or ask for personal information
Description.PIIDetail:
It's against the rules to share personal information or ask others to share theirs.
This includes phone numbers, email addresses, real names, and phyiscal addresses.
Description.PIIDetail.V2:
It's against the rules to share personal information or ask others to share theirs.
This includes:
Description.PIIImportance: Personal information shared with a bad actor can be used to harm you. This can lead to bullying or threats.
Description.PIIImportance.V2: If a stranger figures out who you are in real life, they can try to contact you outside of Roblox. This can be dangerous because it’s hard to know online who someone really is.
Description.SpamDetail: Spamming involves repetitive, unwanted, or repeated messaging and isn't allowed.
Description.SpamDetail.V2: It's not okay to repeatedly send the same message over and over again.
Description.SpamImportance: Spamming disrupts the experience for others and makes it hard to follow conversations.
Description.ExtortionDetail: Threatening or blackmailing others for money or favors, or forcing someone to do something you want, isn't allowed.
Description.ExtortionImportance: Extortion and blackmail can be harmful as it threatens users' safety and privacy and makes users feel uncomfortable and potentially unsafe.
Description.ViolentDetail: Violent content that depicts serious physical harm, graphic violence, or gore isn't allowed.
Description.ViolentImportance: Graphic or extremely violent content can be traumatic or upsetting, especially for younger users.
Description.DatingDetail: Romantic behaviours such as kissing, dating, or sexting aren't allowed. Keep conversations friendly, not flirty.
Description.DatingDetail.V2: When you chat, keep it friendly and not flirty. Romantic behaviors like kissing or dating aren't allowed. It’s also important that avatar clothes aren't too revealing.
Description.DatingImportance: Keeping chats friendly helps make sure everyone of all ages feels comfortable and safe.
Description.HarmfulDetail: Content that encourages, instructs, promotes, or praises dangerous activities isn't allowed.
Description.HarmfulDetail.V2: Content that encourages, instructs, or promotes real-life dangerous activities isn't allowed.
Description.HarmfulImportance: Encouraging or providing instructions for dangerous activities can cause real-world harm.
Heading.SexualHeaderTop: Keep it appropriate for all ages
Description.SexualDetail: Sexual content, including simulated or real nudity, isn't allowed. This also includes profile pictures, usernames, and display names.
Description.SexualImportance: Sexual content isn't appropriate for all ages and can make people uncomfortable, especially younger users.
Description.ImpersonationDetail: Pretending to be someone you’re not isn't allowed. This also includes impersonating Boiby staff members or administrators.
Description.ImpersonationImportance: Impersonation can be used to mislead or confuse others, and may harm the reputation of the person being impersonated.
Heading.RuleExplanation.MisusingSystemsH: Don't cheat, lie, or try to get around rules
Description.MisusingSystemsDetail: It’s against the rules to cheat or bypass our systems or share ways to do that on Boiby. For example:
Label.MisuingSystemsDotpoint1: Trying to get around the rules and evade detection
Label.MisuingSystemsDotpoint2: Reporting users for things that didn’t happen
Label.MisuingSystemsDotpoint3: Lying to trick people into doing something
Label.MisuingSystemsDotpoint4: Creating a new account to get around rules that keep Boiby safe
Description.MisusingSystemsImportance: Boiby stays fun for everyone when we all follow rules and act responsibly and honestly, so that no one has an unfair advantage.
Description.UndisclosedAdsDetail: Posting ads or promotional content without disclosure or without using our advertisement systems isn't allowed.
Description.UndisclosedAdsImportance: Honesty and transparency about advertisements and proper use helps maintain trust within the Boiby community.
Heading.MisinformationHeaderTop.V2: Be careful with what you share
Description.MisinformationDetail: Spreading false or misleading information that can cause harm to users or communities isn't allowed on Boiby.
Description.MisinformationImportance: Spereading misleading information can be harmful to users and communities, especially regarding serious or sensitive topics.
Description.PoliticalDetail: Any content that directly or indirectly promotes, mentions, or otherwise discusses political figures or entities isn't allowed.
Description.PoliticalImportance: To ensure a safe and neutral platform for all users, we don't allow content that discusses or promotes political figures or entities.
Heading.RuleExplanation.SensitiveEventsH: Don't take advantage of sensitive events
Description.SensitiveEventsDetail: Taking advantage of or exploiting real-world sensitive events for personal gain or attention is not allowed.
Description.SensitiveEventsImportance: Exploiting sensitive real-world events can cause harm or distress to those affected, and is disrespectful to anyone involved.
Description.ScammingDetail: Attempting to scam or deceive users for personal gain through any means isn't allowed. This includes phishing links, fake offers, and misleading rewards.
Description.ScammingImportance: Scamming and deception can cause loss of items and money or identity theft, which can harm users and damage trust within the community.
Heading.DisruptiveAudioHeaderTop: Use your voice to contribute, not disrupt
Description.DisruptiveAudioDetail: Audio content that's disruptive, overly loud, or harmful isn't allowed. This includes screaming and loud or annoying noises.
Description.DisruptiveAudioImportance: Disruptive or loud audio can be painful or startling, and can disrupt or ruin the experience for others.
Heading.RuleExplanation.ChargebackHeader: Don't abuse refunds or make chargebacks
Description.ChargebackDetail: Submitting multiple refund requests or making chargebacks without a valid reason is not allowed. This includes disputing legitimate transactions through your bank.
Description.ChargebackImportance: Unfair chargebacks and refund abuse cause problems and can prevent us from providing a quality service to all users.
Description.IllegalContentDetail: The promotion, sale, or discussion of illegal items, controlled substances, or regulated goods is prohibited on our platform.
Description.IllegalContentImportance: Discussion of illegal or regulated goods or services puts our users at risk and threatens the safety of our community, especially those under 18.
Description.IPViolationDetail: Uploading content that you don't own the rights to, including copyrighted music, videos, and art, isn't allowed without permission from the creator.
Description.IPViolationImportance: Protecting other users' intellectual property rights ensures that creators are fairly credited for their hard work.
Heading.CheatingHeaderTop: Play fair and keep it fun
Heading.RuleExplanation.CheatingHeader: Don't use cheats, hacks, or exploits
Description.CheatingDetail: Using cheats to gain an unfair advantage or modifying client files for cheating isn't allowed.
Description.CheatingImportance: Cheating and exploiting can ruin the experience for everyone else because it makes things unfair.
Heading.GenericViolationHeaderTop.V2: Make sure you follow the rules
Description.GenericViolationDetail: To help keep our platform safe and enjoyable, all users must follow our Community Standards.
Description.GenericViolationImportance: Following rules ensures a respectful community where all users can safely enjoy Boiby without disruption or harm.
Heading.RuleExplanation.OffPlatformHeade: No sharing links off of Boiby
Description.OffPlatformDetail: It’s against the rules to share links in chat to other websites or tell people how to find your profile on other apps or social media, unless it is an allowed site added to the social connections section of your profile. If someone tells you to go to another website that looks dangerous, you shouldn’t do it and always stay on Boiby.
Description.OffPlatformImportance: Links may take you to fake websites that look just like Boiby to steal your account or items. The sites could also have harmful images or videos.
Description.SwearingDetail:
It’s against the rules to use swear words. This includes using misspellings, symbols, or other methods to try to get around detection systems.

Only users over 16 in certain 16+ only spaces are allowed to use strong language, as long it isn't used to harass anyone.
Description.SwearingImportance: Boiby is for everyone, including young kids. We use words that are respectful and welcoming for our entire community.
